description: JavaScript code for managing email recipient input fields in SuiteCRM, including dynamic form manipulation, AJAX requests for email field retrieval, and UI element show/hide functions.

methods.name: show_emailField
methods.description: Fetches and displays email input fields based on recipient type via AJAX.

methods.name: load_emailline
methods.description: Creates a new email line and initializes it with specified type and value.

methods.name: add_emailLine
methods.description: Dynamically adds a new email recipient input row to the form.

methods.name: clear_emailLine
methods.description: Removes a specific email input row from the form.

methods.name: clear_emailLines
methods.description: Removes all email input rows from the form.

methods.name: hideElem
methods.description: Hides a DOM element and clears its value.

methods.name: assign_field_change
methods.description: Adjusts visibility of related fields based on selected value.
